# VAD Emotion Detection System - Final Results

## Project Overview

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
## Read More

This project builds a machine learning model that predicts emotional meaning in text using the Valence–Arousal–Dominance (VAD) framework. A dataset of more than 300,000 labeled text samples was created using EmoBank, synthetic data generation, and game server logs. The text was transformed into embeddings with a SentenceTransformer model, and a multi-output Ridge Regression model was trained to estimate the three VAD dimensions. The final model achieved strong performance in predicting emotional tone and demonstrates an efficient, interpretable approach for emotion analysis in real-time text applications. Read more on my capstone here.
:::

## Key Achievements

- Variance scores >0.70 across all three emotional dimensions
- Over 300,000 labeled text entries
- Real-time emotional tone detection and adaptation

## Applications

- Customer service chatbots
- Mental health monitoring
- Educational tools
- Community moderation
